Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Object, o As Object, s As String, v As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    wb.Worksheets.Add After:=wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Activate
    wb.Worksheets(2).Range("A1").Value = "z"
    ws.Range("A1:C1").Value = Array("a", "b", "c")
    ws.Range("A2:C2").Value = Array(1, 2, 3)
    ws.Range("A3:C3").Value = Array(4, 5, 6)
    ws.Range("A4:C4").Value = Array(7, 8, 9)
    ws.Range("A5:C5").Value = Array(10, 11, 12)
    Set o = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:C5"), , xlYes)
    o.Name = "T"
    ws.Range("H1").Value = "h"
    ws.Range("I1").Value = "i"
    ws.Range("H10").Formula = "=SUM(T[a])"
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        
    Case 1
        ws.Range("A1:C5").Cut ws.Range("D3")
    Case 2
        ws.Range("A1:C5").Cut ws.Range("B2")
    Case 3
        ws.Range("A1:C5").Cut wb.Worksheets(2).Range("B2")
    Case 4
        o.Range.Cut ws.Range("J1")
    Case 5
        o.ShowTotals = True: o.Range.Cut ws.Range("J1")
    Case 6
        ws.Range("A1:C5").Cut: ws.Paste ws.Range("J1")
    Case 7
        ws.Range("A1:C5").Cut: ws.Range("J1").Select: ActiveSheet.Paste
    Case 8
        ws.Range("A1:D6").Cut ws.Range("J1")
    Case 9
        ws.Range("A1:C6").Cut ws.Range("J1")
    Case 10
        ws.Range("A1:D5").Cut ws.Range("J1")
    Case 11
        ws.Rows("1:5").Cut ws.Rows(11)
    Case 12
        ws.Columns("A:C").Cut ws.Columns("J")
    Case 13
        o.Range.AutoFilter 1, ">1": o.Range.Cut ws.Range("J1")
    Case 14
        ws.Range("A1:C5").Cut ws.Range("A1")
    Case 15
        ws.Range("A2:C5").Cut ws.Range("J1")
    Case 16
        o.DataBodyRange.Cut ws.Range("J1")
    Case 17
        ws.Range("A3:C3").Cut ws.Range("J1")
    Case 18
        ws.Range("B1:B5").Cut ws.Range("J1")
    Case 19
        ws.Range("B2:B5").Cut ws.Range("J1")
    Case 20
        ws.Range("B3").Cut ws.Range("J1")
    Case 21
        ws.Range("A1:C1").Cut ws.Range("J1")
    Case 22
        ws.Range("A1").Cut ws.Range("J1")
    Case 23
        ws.Range("A1:B2").Cut ws.Range("J1")
    Case 24
        ws.Range("A2").Cut ws.Range("B3")
    Case 25
        ws.Range("A2:A3").Cut ws.Range("C4")
    Case 26
        ws.Range("A1").Cut ws.Range("B1")
    Case 27
        ws.Range("A2").Cut ws.Range("A1")
    Case 28
        ws.Range("A1:A5").Cut ws.Range("C1")
    Case 29
        ws.Range("A3:C3").Cut ws.Range("A5")
    Case 30
        ws.Range("H1").Cut ws.Range("B3")
    Case 31
        ws.Range("H1").Cut ws.Range("B1")
    Case 32
        ws.Range("H1").Cut ws.Range("D2")
    Case 33
        ws.Range("H1").Cut ws.Range("B6")
    Case 34
        ws.Range("H1:I2").Cut ws.Range("C5")
    Case 35
        ws.Range("H1:I2").Cut ws.Range("A1")
    Case 36
        wb.Worksheets(2).Range("A1").Cut ws.Range("B3")
    End Select
    s = "ok "
Answered:
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.ListObjects.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = wb.Worksheets(2).ListObjects.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = o.Range.Parent.Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = o.Range.Address
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = o.DataBodyRange.Address
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = o.HeaderRowRange.Address
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = o.ListColumns(1).Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = o.ListColumns(2).Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("A1").Value
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("B3").Value
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("D3").Value
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("J1").Value
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("H10").Formula
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("H10").Value
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.AutoFilterMode
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = o.ShowAutoFilter
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = o.AutoFilter.Range.Address
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = Application.CutCopyMode
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("A1").ListObject Is Nothing
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("J1").ListObject Is Nothing
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("A2").Interior.Color
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = s
    Application.CutCopyMode = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number & " "
    Resume Answered
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String, ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
